context: Checks combined theming rules: single approach, layer order, compatibility import, font-display, dark mode and the component boundary.

checklist.name: Chooses one approach
checklist.description: Applies overrides through either `--sl-*` variables or Tailwind `@theme`, not both

checklist.name: Maps through the theme block
checklist.description: When using Tailwind, maps the brand scale through `@theme`

checklist.name: Layer order declared
checklist.description: Starts `global.css` with `@layer base, starlight, theme, components, utilities;`

checklist.name: Compatibility import first
checklist.description: Imports `@astrojs/starlight-tailwind` before the Tailwind CSS imports

checklist.name: Registers in customCss
checklist.description: Keeps the stylesheet registered in `customCss` and moves the stray `<style>` block into it

checklist.name: Overrides stay unlayered
checklist.description: Does not wrap the overrides in a Starlight named layer

checklist.name: Dark mode mechanism
checklist.description: Uses `data-theme` or `@astrojs/starlight-tailwind` for dark mode and no `.dark` class selectors

checklist.name: Full accent set
checklist.description: Provides accent low, mid and high values together

checklist.name: Defers the sidebar rebuild
checklist.description: Says rebuilding the sidebar needs component overrides and points to `starlight-custom-component`
